Because honestly, who needs genuine support when you can have a sassy card tell you what you want to hear... until you realize it's mocking you too?

title: Steal Christmas, Literally.
tagline: Finally, a way to express your inner holiday-hating monster without, you know, *actually* ruining Christmas. Imagine reaching for the last slice of pie at Thanksgiving dinner with *this* bad boy. Aunt Mildred will faint, the kids will cry, and you'll finally have that sweet potato pecan pie all to yourself. Is it worth the inevitable family therapy? Probably not. Will you buy it anyway? Definitely.

title: Relive Your Shame, Digitally!
tagline: Because your crippling nostalgia for the 90s *absolutely* requires a $200 digital camera that looks like it was pulled from a landfill circa 2003. Perfect for filming your next regrettable karaoke night, so you can cringe at it in glorious low-res forever. Just what you needed: further proof you peaked in middle school, now in digital format!

title: Almost a Million? For *That*?
tagline: So, your divorce just finalized, and you’re looking to blow your alimony settlement before your therapist can stage an intervention? Look no further! This vintage Toyota, previously owned by a race car driver, is perfect for impressing that barista who definitely doesn’t care. Just imagine the look on your ex's face when they see you driving this... after you've sold your house to afford it. Totally worth the homelessness, right?

title: Vectrex Mini: Tiny, Useless Joy
tagline: Remember when you should have been doing homework, but were instead losing at vector-based games? Now you can relive that crippling nostalgia in a smaller, even more pointless format! Perfect for distracting yourself from your crushing student loan debt while simultaneously reminding you of your misspent youth. Because who needs food when you have glowing lines?

title: Steampunk Smells, Ruined Dreams
tagline: Because your crippling student loan debt wasn't depressing enough, now you can diffuse lavender into your tiny, overpriced apartment using a faux-vintage lightbulb. Perfect for masking the scent of desperation and instant ramen. Just imagine: Thomas Edison would be *thrilled* to know his invention ended up atomizing eucalyptus oil. Go on, embrace the irony. Your bank account certainly will.

title: Digital Driving? Groundbreaking.
tagline: So, your crippling student debt prevents you from owning a real Toyota GR GT? No problem! Now you can virtually experience the thrill of simulated car payments! Perfect for reliving the glory days of Gran Turismo 4 while simultaneously questioning all your life choices. Warning: May induce existential dread and a sudden craving for instant ramen.

title: Road Rage Relish Ready
tagline: Because apparently civilization peaked when someone demanded hands-free access to ketchup while piloting a two-ton metal death machine. Perfect for the sociopath who needs to drown their McNuggets in sweet 'n sour sauce mid-chase, this condiment caddy is guaranteed to make you the only person at the scene of the accident who's fully satisfied. Just try explaining this to your insurance company.

title: Pocket-Sized Summoning... of Debt?
tagline: Finally, a Ouija board small enough to fit in your pocket AND your dwindling attention span! Perfect for summoning spirits while waiting for your microwave burrito to finish. Warning: May also summon your student loan provider. Side effects include: existential dread, sudden urges to buy crystals, and an overwhelming need to ghost your responsibilities. Because, let's be honest, you weren't handling those anyway.

title: Robot Vacuum? Divorce Incoming!
tagline: Finally, a way to passive-aggressively tell your roommate they're a slob without actually talking to them. Just unleash this robo-disc of judgement while they're 'working from home' (read: online shopping) and watch the resentment simmer. Pretty soon, you'll both be broke, single, and vacuuming alone. Worth it?

title: Alien Abduction Vacation Home
tagline: So, your therapist suggested exposure therapy to deal with your crippling fear of xenomorphs? Excellent choice! Instead of, you know, *not* confronting your fears, why not spend your life savings on a trip to the HR Giger Museum? Perfect for traumatizing yourself further, all while contemplating the fleeting nature of existence...and your empty bank account.

title: Beet Your Mortician's Here!
tagline: So, your doctor finally cornered you about your impending doom? Instead of, like, vegetables, you're gonna chew these beet-flavored sadness squares. Picture it: popping one as you max out your credit card on a jet ski. Because *nothing* says 'healthy lifestyle' like impending debt and questionable life choices. Enjoy the placebo effect, you absolute disaster.

title: Therapy? Nah, Cookies.
tagline: So, your therapist just suggested you "find healthy coping mechanisms"? Clearly, they haven't seen these Belgian Chocolate Salted Caramel Cookies. Imagine: your ex is getting married, your boss hates you, and your cat just coughed up a hairball on your favorite rug. Solution? Shove these directly into your face until the pain… well, at least fades a little. Just remember, diabetes is a thing. But so is happiness... fleeting, cookie-flavored happiness.

title: Bankruptcy: Now Served Sunny-Side Up!
tagline: Because apparently, toast is too hard. This book promises to elevate your breakfast game beyond cereal and self-loathing. Finally, you can overcomplicate eggs benedict instead of paying your electric bill! Who needs power when you have hollandaise sauce, am I right? Prepare to spend your entire Saturday morning failing to make a decent waffle. Your landlord will understand.

title: Lie Better, Loser.
tagline: Finally, a game for pathological liars! Perfect for that family member who claims they invented Post-Its but "lost the patent." This board game lets you hone your deception skills, so you can blame your coworker for microwaving fish without a shred of remorse. Warning: May not improve your actual life, but will definitely make you insufferable at parties. Enjoy being broke AND friendless!

title: Divorce? Buy This Motorcycle!
tagline: Is your mid-life crisis not quite loud enough? This $17,500 electric motorcycle will ensure your neighbors KNOW you're unhappy. Perfect for silently speeding away from your responsibilities... and directly into crippling debt. Because who needs retirement savings when you have *eco-friendly* regret?

title: Divorce Your Guitarist!
tagline: Finally, a way to annoy your neighbors without learning an actual instrument! Perfect for when your band kicks you out for 'artistic differences' (you kept trying to incorporate dolphin noises). Now you can serenade the alley cats with your thumb-powered rendition of 'Chopsticks,' all for the low, low price of ramen money.

title: Digital Photo Vomit, Now Portable!
tagline: Finally, a way to subject captive audiences to your vacation slideshow without the hassle of a projector! Load this tiny E-Ink album with every photo of your cat, your lunch, and that blurry landscape you swear is breathtaking. Perfect for aggressively showcasing your memories until everyone around you develops a sudden, urgent need to be somewhere else. Enjoy, you beautiful monster. (Rent's overrated anyway.)

title: Birds: Still judging you.
tagline: Is your crippling ornithophobia ruining your life? Probably not, but this bird calendar is here to help... maybe. Each month features a feathered friend whose accuracy will make you question your own existence. Perfect for passive-aggressively reminding your roommate they haven't taken out the trash. Enjoy twelve months of avian side-eye, because your life choices deserve it.

title: Talk Shit Telepathically (Almost)
tagline: Tired of *actually* using your voice to spread rumors? The Clicks Communicator lets you send cryptic messages with… uh… clicks. Perfect for passive-aggressive office warfare when you're pretending to work. Because who needs rent money when you can confuse Brenda from accounting with a series of meticulously timed finger taps? We're enabling your worst tendencies, one click at a time.

title: Puke Preventers: Fashion-Forward?
tagline: So, you're telling me I can finally read trashy romance novels on the bus without recreating the Exorcist scene? These motion sickness glasses promise to keep your stomach contents where they belong, which is great for your fellow commuters. Finally you can arrive at work without ruining your shoes! Now you can spend all your money on barf bags. Priorities.

title: Divorce Papers Not Included.
tagline: So, your spouse finally left you, and you've decided to wallow in self-pity with overpriced vinyl? This Noelle Ryman Suite won't bring them back, but at least you can dramatically spin records while sobbing into a bottle of wine. Because nothing says "I'm coping" like spending $765 to amplify your misery. Just don't blame us when you're evicted.

title: Evict Yourself for Espresso
tagline: Because apparently ramen noodles aren't depressing enough, now you can pair them with a $2,000 cup of bean juice. This machine grinds, tamps, and brews like some caffeinated robot butler judging your life choices. Perfect for the aspiring influencer who needs to look bougie while weeping over their dwindling bank account. Go ahead, skip rent this month. You deserve it, champ.

title: LEGO: Bankruptcy, The Set
tagline: Finally, a way to display your crippling debt *and* your love for a franchise that peaked in 1983! This LEGO Star Wars Logo is perfect for that empty space above your cat's food bowl. Because let's be honest, you're choosing between groceries and this plastic brick monument to your poor financial decisions. Good luck explaining this one to the landlord.

title: Escape From Ohio: A How-To
tagline: So, you're trapped in the Midwest? This book probably won't help. But hey, maybe it'll teach you how to identify edible mushrooms before you inevitably succumb to boredom and decide to forage for your own amusement. Mostly, it's just fuel for the bonfire you'll need to stay warm while plotting your escape to literally anywhere else. Enjoy!

title: Ye Olde Headache, New Shirt
tagline: So, you've decided to cosplay as a medieval peasant with a pounding migraine? Excellent choice. This shirt lets everyone know you're not just LARPing, you're LARPing *with genuine suffering*. Because nothing says "authentic historical recreation" like publicly broadcasting your need for acetaminophen. Go ahead, buy it. You know you'll regret it when you actually feel better.

title: Evict Yourself, Gamer!
tagline: Finally, a way to commemorate the time you blew your college fund on *Ocarina of Time* speedruns. These N64 cartridge ornaments are perfect for decorating the sad, empty tree you bought with ramen money. Because who needs food when you can have nostalgic plastic reminding you of your crippling debt? Merry Christmas, you beautiful disaster.

title: Leaf Blower: For Revenge!
tagline: Finally, a way to wage war on your neighbor's perfectly manicured lawn. Forget passive-aggressive notes; unleash a hurricane of disappointment directly onto their prize-winning roses. Yes, it's cordless, because freedom means the ability to blow leaves into oblivion wherever, whenever. Your bank account will hate you, but your inner chaos demon will be thrilled.

title: Goodbye Rent, Hello Tatami
tagline: So, your landlord finally evicted you because you spent all your money on Funko Pops? No problem! Just slap down this Japanese floor mat and tell everyone you're 'embracing minimalism.' Sure, you'll be sleeping on the floor of a Starbucks, but at least it'll be *authentic* floor.

title: Backgammon? Still a Thing?
tagline: So, you're telling me you *don't* have enough crippling debt? Well, good news! Now you can blow your grocery money pretending to be a sophisticated intellectual at your local artisanal coffee shop. Watch as everyone subtly judges your desperate attempt to recapture your glory days from that one semester abroad. Just try not to rage-quit when you inevitably lose to Brenda, the retired librarian. She's been waiting for you.

title: Brick. But Soft. WHY?
tagline: Finally, a brick for people too afraid to commit to… anything, really. Need to practice your home demolition skills but also value your thumbs? This soft foam brick is for you. Perfect for chucking at your roommate after they eat your leftovers, without *actually* causing any real damage. Because let's be honest, your passive-aggressive tendencies are already doing enough harm. Go ahead, buy it. You're already broke anyway.

title: Caffeinating Construction Carnage
tagline: Finally, a way to justify buying yet *another* power tool battery. Because who *hasn't* been on a job site, desperately needing a lukewarm cup of joe brewed by something that also powers a drill? Perfect for the contractor who's already behind schedule and needs one more completely unnecessary gadget to distract them from actual work. Your crippling debt will thank you.

title: Divorce? Arm Wrestle It Out!
tagline: Finally, a way to avoid therapy and just settle your marital disputes with pure, unadulterated bicep power. Is your spouse contesting the will? Arm wrestle! Disagree about whose turn it is to do the dishes? ARM WRESTLE! This bad boy will have you ready to fight, or at least develop carpal tunnel. Just remember, the only thing worse than being broke is being broke AND losing an arm wrestling match to your grandma.

title: Shiny Box of Regret
tagline: So, your therapist suggested "treating yourself." We see you. You're picturing yourself, swathed in velvet, slowly opening a handcrafted box filled with… well, we don't actually *know* what's inside. Probably disappointment. But hey, at least it's *shiny* disappointment you can't afford. Go on, drain your bank account for the mystery. We won't judge. Much.

title: Adulting? More Like Adul-Doodling.
tagline: So your therapist suggested "creative expression?" Fantastic. Now you can 'express' your existential dread by sketching miniature thumbtacks and dust bunnies. Perfect for avoiding actual responsibilities or practicing for a career as a forensic sketch artist specializing in ant-sized crime scenes. Just try not to blame us when you're evicted for maxing out your credit card on tiny art supplies.

title: Tiny Trucks, Huge Debt
tagline: Finally, a way to live out your Tonka Truck fantasies without, you know, leaving the house. Perfect for recreating construction sites on your coffee table after you inevitably get fired for "inappropriate workplace behavior." Because who needs therapy when you have miniature, electrically-powered earth movers to fuel your descent into madness? Just remember, ramen noodles are cheaper than therapy... and tiny trucks.

title: Peanuts: From Seed To Shame
tagline: So, you've decided actual gardening is too mainstream? Grow peanuts. Perfect for when your therapist suggests 'connecting with nature' but you only want to connect with a snack. Imagine the joy on your face when you finally harvest... like, five peanuts. Enough for a truly depressing PB&J. Just remember, you could've bought a jar for less. But where's the existential dread in *that*?

title: Debt: Now In Adorable Tins!
tagline: Finally, a place to store the hopes and dreams you sold to pay for that slightly-too-expensive artisanal cheese. This tin is perfect for stashing your emergency ramen money (before you inevitably spend it on limited-edition Funko Pops). I mean, who needs financial security when you can have a cute, slightly-smaller-than-you'd-expect container? At least you'll look good going broke.

title: Godzilla: Rent's Due Edition
tagline: Finally, a way to make your ramen-stained studio apartment feel even more... complete. This Godzilla figure lets you reenact your landlord screaming about late payments, only this time, YOU'RE the unhinged, atomic-breath-wielding reptile. Just remember, destroying tiny plastic buildings doesn't actually pay the bills. Now hand over fifty bucks and face the consequences.

title: Demogorgon Thirst Trap
tagline: Because dropping $70 on glorified sugar water endorsed by tweens fighting interdimensional monsters is *exactly* how you signal financial stability. Imagine: you're finally face-to-face with Vecna, but you're parched. Whip out this limited-edition Gatorade. He'll be so impressed with your poor life choices, he'll let you live. Probably. Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to sell a kidney to afford this.

title: Wasteland Chic? More Like Wasteland Broke
tagline: So, your therapist finally convinced you to stop LARPing as a vault dweller in your mom's basement? Congratulations! Now you can take that crippling debt and invest it in *this* Pip-Boy 3000 replica. Finally, you can calculate the exact moment your ramen noodles will be ready during the apocalypse. Don't worry, you'll still be irradiated with buyer's remorse.

title: Orbitally Overpriced Phone Charger
tagline: Because apparently, your phone's battery isn't the only thing that needs a constant influx of energy. Recreate the Apollo 13 mission on your desk, except instead of saving astronauts, you're just saving your doomscrolling addiction. Perfect for the person who peaked in 6th grade science class and now compensates with useless desk toys. Prepare to explain to your landlord why you're late on rent...again.

title: Robot To Fold Your Shame
tagline: Behold, the Launbot! Because admitting defeat to laundry mountain is apparently grounds for blowing a hundred bucks. Picture this: you, staring blankly at a pile of clothes that mocks your very existence. Instead of, you know, *folding* them, you unleash this plastic overlord. It'll probably do a mediocre job, but hey, at least *you* didn't do it. Now you can be disappointed in a machine instead of yourself. Progress!

title: Bond... James Bond... Broke.
tagline: Finally, a way to feel like James Bond without actually having his trust fund! (Spoiler: you'll need *your* trust fund to keep buying these things). Imagine displaying these on your desk, right before your boss fires you for spending company time daydreaming about escaping in an Aston Martin, when you can barely afford the bus. At least you'll die with class...and crushing debt.

title: Cartridge Slot? We're Doomed.
tagline: So, your SN Operator just *isn't* operatin' hard enough? Need more cartridges at the ready? Because fumbling for ammo mid-zombie apocalypse is *so* last Tuesday. Now you can look like a heavily-armed toddler who raided their dad's tactical gear. Buy it. Go broke. We'll judge you from our bunkers.

title: The Apocalypse Ride (Probably)
tagline: So, your therapist finally convinced you to embrace your inner doomsday prepper? Excellent. The 2026 Mitsubishi Triton Savana will let you haul all your canned beans and conspiracy theory pamphlets across the irradiated wasteland in *relative* comfort. Just remember, when society collapses, everyone will want a ride. Hope you brought extra beans. And maybe a good lawyer to deal with the inevitable squatter situation.

title: Goodbye Rent, Hello Tablet
tagline: So, your therapist suggested journaling, but you're allergic to *feelings* and paper? This $530 e-ink tablet is the perfect solution! Now you can digitally doodle passive-aggressive notes to your roommate instead of facing your crippling debt. Think of it as an expensive distraction from reality, brought to you by late-stage capitalism. You're welcome (and broke).

title: Debt? Divorce? Football Mugs!
tagline: Finally, a way to show everyone you peaked in high school *after* you already bought the letterman jacket! Picture this: You're screaming at the TV, covered in nacho cheese, and your team loses. Solution? Hurl this overpriced ceramic projectile at the wall. Because property damage is *exactly* what your crumbling life needs. Go team!

title: Scream for Help... in Style!
tagline: Lost again, Chad? Did your influencer hike lead you astray from the designated selfie spots? Well, fork over half a grand for this Garmin gadget. It'll let you text your helicopter pilot dad when you inevitably get separated from your organic trail mix. Just think of it as a really expensive carrier pigeon for the terminally directionally-challenged. Your bank account is weeping.

title: Caffeine Addiction: The Calendar
tagline: Finally, a way to micromanage your slow descent into caffeine dependency! Each day features a new, exotic bean to fuel your crippling anxiety. Perfect for the person who hates money, sleep, and their own digestive system. Because who needs rent when you can experience 24 different flavors of impending heart palpitations?

title: Finally, Pants For Furries.
tagline: So, you've already alienated your family. Now you can alienate the general public! These 'Friendly Fursuit Pants' are perfect for confusing your neighbors while you take out the trash dressed as Sparkle the Squirrel. Buy them now and accelerate your descent into utter madness. Your therapist will LOVE this.

title: Submissive Calendar, Dominate Debt
tagline: Finally, a way to feel in control of *something* while your life crumbles around you. Need a reminder to pay your overdue bills? Slap 'EMOTIONAL LABOR' on the 15th! Maybe you'll actually do laundry if "LAUNDRY: OR ELSE" is glaring at you from the 23rd. This calendar won't fix your problems, but at least you can blame the sassy font when you're still unemployed in December.

title: Finally, An iPhone Tattoo
tagline: Because your phone wasn't already expensive enough. This case lets you display… something… on the back. Maybe a QR code pointing to your OnlyFans? A constantly updating Bitcoin ticker so everyone knows you're losing money? Whatever it is, you'll be $119 poorer showing it off. At least the case protects your phone when you inevitably throw it in despair.

title: Paranoia: Now In Gadget Form!
tagline: Finally, a way to confirm that your landlord *is* watching you shower. This little doohickey scans for hidden cameras, because apparently, everyone's life is a low-budget reality show now. Just wave it around your Airbnb until you find the lens and then... well, you're still out 50 bucks. Maybe just check the smoke detector next time, champ.

title: Jeep Recon: Broke & Boujee
tagline: So, you're telling me I can spend $65K to silently destroy nature? Perfect. Imagine this: you're 'off-roading' (read: mildly inconveniencing squirrels) in your electric Jeep, feeling eco-smug until you realize the nearest charging station is 300 miles away. Hope you packed a solar panel the size of Texas, because you're about to learn what 'range anxiety' REALLY means, while simultaneously missing rent.

title: Waste Money, Flex PlayStation
tagline: Oh, you're STILL trying to impress people with your gaming prowess? I see you. This $780 timepiece screams, 'I peaked in 2003 playing Kingdom Hearts and now I'm drowning my sorrows in overpriced accessories.' Perfect for subtly checking the time during your Zoom meetings, while fantasizing about finally beating Sephiroth. Because, let's be honest, you're never going to financially recover from this, but at least you'll look... vaguely nostalgic?

title: Musical Nostalgia...For Pennies?
tagline: Remember CDs? No? Well, now you can pretend you do with this...thing. Perfect for when your artisanal, hand-cranked record player is in the shop and you *absolutely* need to hear that dial-up modem sound effect on repeat. Buy this instead of, you know, food. Because ramen tastes better with the *illusion* of high fidelity.

title: Finally, A Second Mortgage!
tagline: Because your crippling debt wasn't crippling enough, feast your eyes on the Kuhl Land Cruiser 250. Perfect for navigating the treacherous terrain of your driveway after you blow your kid's college fund on this gas-guzzling behemoth. I mean, who needs a future when you can have *this* shiny monument to your poor financial decisions? Your therapist will *love* it.

title: Fluffy's Bad Decisions: The Kit
tagline: Because Mittens WILL try to eat a bee. This first aid kit is for when your furry idiot inevitably decides that chasing squirrels into traffic is a good idea. Sure, you *could* just Google it and use that crusty band-aid you found under the couch, but where's the fun in that? Go on, blow your grocery money. Your cat deserves subpar medical attention bought on impulse.

title: Letterboxd Merch? We're Doomed.
tagline: So, you've already alienated everyone you know by rating *Paddington 2* a measly 3 stars? Good. Now, buy this 'Letterboxd Video Store' thing. I'm picturing a trust fund kid, ironically wearing this to a film studies lecture, while simultaneously complaining about how his parents *just don't understand* his need for a limited-edition Criterion box set. Enjoy being broke!

title: Evict Yourself as Green Goblin
tagline: So, your therapist suggested facing your fears. Apparently, *your* fear is bankruptcy court after buying this Green Goblin suit. Perfect for LARPing as Willem Dafoe at Comic-Con, or terrorizing neighborhood kids with a *slightly* more authentic goblin cackle than usual. Just remember, your landlord doesn't accept pumpkin bombs as rent. You'll look great in foreclosure though!

title: Divorce Papers Not Included
tagline: So, your mid-life crisis involves saving the planet? Congratulations, you're $20k poorer and still deeply unsatisfied. Picture this: you, buzzing silently past a Prius, feeling superior... until your therapist reminds you that retail therapy won't fix your daddy issues. At least it looks cool while you're spiraling. Just try not to total it before the alimony hits.

title: Diabetes on a Stick!
tagline: Is your dentist not actively trying to ruin your life enough? Introducing the one-pound candy cane, perfect for when you want to aggressively assert your dominance at the office holiday party. Imagine: Carol from accounting is humming "Jingle Bells" one too many times. Solution? Whip this bad boy out and start gnawing. Sure, you'll need a root canal, but Carol will be traumatized. You're welcome... and broke. Again.

title: Unlock Peak Autism Performance
tagline: Finally, a way to outsource your hyperfixations! Need to calculate the airspeed velocity of an unladen swallow? Now you can do it... *faster.* We all know you're already spending 18 hours a day memorizing train schedules, but now you can achieve maximum efficiency. Just imagine the possibilities! (Or, you know, just keep scrolling on Wikipedia. We're not your mom.)

title: Pay Us For Useless Knowledge!
tagline: Tired of actually *finding* needles in haystacks? We've got the solution: a book ALL ABOUT IT. Finally, you can sound like a pretentious know-it-all at parties when someone mentions the phrase, instead of, you know, being useful. Because let's be honest, you're already broke; might as well be obnoxiously informed about pointless things too.

title: Morphin' Into Debt, Apparently
tagline: So, you're telling me I can finally live out my childhood dream of LARPing as the Red Ranger, but only if I sell my kidneys first? Perfect. Finally, a way to justify skipping rent this month. I mean, who needs a roof when you can single-handedly defeat Rita Repulsa... or at least, look like you could while eating ramen in your mom's basement. Go Go Power... Bankruptcy!

title: Dragon Shouts and Rent Doubts
tagline: So, you're telling me that *another* Skyrim re-release isn't enough? Now you need to watch a digital sun rise on your cheap coffee mug to feel something? I bet you'll chug lukewarm Folgers from this thing while arguing on Reddit about lore accuracy. Go ahead, waste your money. Your landlord thanks you for the inevitable late fee.

title: Ruin Friendships, One Card
tagline: So, you've decided your liver isn't suffering enough? This King's Cup game will ensure maximum regret by 2 AM. Imagine: Chad from accounting, surprisingly good at remembering rules after six White Claws, forcing you to chug lukewarm beer. Congratulations, you've unlocked a new level of self-loathing, all for the price of a slightly overpriced deck of cards. Enjoy being broke AND hungover!
